bundled.title: Meeting Rooms II
bundled.content:
Given a list of meeting time intervals where intervals[i] = [start, end], return the minimum number of conference rooms needed to hold every meeting.

A room freed at time t can host a meeting that starts at t.

Example 1:

Input: intervals = [[0,30],[5,10],[15,20]]
Output: 2

Example 2:

Input: intervals = [[7,10],[2,4]]
Output: 1

Example 3:

Input: intervals = [[1,10],[2,9],[3,8]]
Output: 3

Constraints:

  • 1 <= intervals.length <= 10^4
  • intervals[i].length == 2
  • 0 <= start < end <= 10^6
